name: Insight Templates & Elements — Assign Block Templates
author: Bas Buis

sections.description:
Insight Templates & Elements assigns a block template to Pages and Posts.

Per-page and per-post templates are a control often included with themes such as Kadence, Blocksy, GeneratePress, and Astra. This plugin adds that control without replacing the theme.

  1. Activate a block theme (or create templates under Appearance → Editor).
  2. Go to Settings → Insight Templates & Elements.
  3. Open FSE template rules and add a rule.
  4. Save — matching Pages and Posts use the assigned template on the front end.

Free includes:

  • Unlimited template rules for Pages and Posts
  • Rule type: Specific posts or pages (by ID)
  • Rule type: Replace post type (Pages or Posts)
  • Copy FSE templates (duplicate, Export, and Import templates and template parts; JSON; never overwrites)
  • Guide tab with setup help
  • Front-end resolver and editor notice when a rule applies

Option names stay compatible with the Pro add-on, so your rules carry over when you upgrade.

Need more?

Archives, other post types, header and footer swaps, and overlay elements are not part of this plugin. They live in the optional Insight Templates & Elements Pro plugin:
* Template rules for archives, categories, tags, the blog index, and the static front page
* Custom post types and WooCommerce views
* Exclusions (post IDs, taxonomy) and visibility (logged-in / logged-out)
* Header and footer template part overrides, with an optional sticky header
* Overlay elements (fixed UI, post content replacement, Woo product content canvas)
* Automatic updates for that plugin
sections.installation:
1. Install from WordPress.org, or upload the insight-templates-elements folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Insight Templates & Elements.
  4. Open FSE template rules and create your first rule.

Do not activate this free plugin together with Insight Templates & Elements Pro (insight-templates-elements-pro). Use one or the other.
sections.faq:
Do I need a license key?

No. The free plugin runs fully for Pages and Posts. There is no license key field in Free.

Can I use custom post types or archives?

Those options are in the optional Insight Templates & Elements Pro add-on.

Will my rules transfer if I upgrade to Pro?

Yes. Rule storage uses the same option names (fse_ta_rules, and related keys).

What happens if Pro is already active?

The free plugin returns early and shows an admin notice. Deactivate Pro only if you want to run Free alone.

Is this a header or footer builder?

No. This plugin assigns the template. Header and footer swaps, archives, custom post types, and overlay elements are in the optional Pro plugin.
